title: Manager, Training and Enablement
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 
 At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.
 How You'll Make an Impact: 
 As Manager, Training & Enablement , you will lead the team that empowers Cloudbeds colleagues and customers through product and hotel operations training. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs, run an efficient AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. Reporting to the SVP of Customer Success, this is a hands-on leadership role with room to shape functional strategy and grow your impact as the team scales. 
 Our Training & Enablement Team: 
 We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. We build with a test-and-learn mindset and use AI to strip out drafting and lookup work, so people can focus on teaching, judgment and quality. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. 
 What You Bring to the Team: 
 • Lead, coach and develop the team across knowledge, delivery and operations, managing hiring, capacity planning and the metrics that justify headcount, while keeping workloads sustainable as release volume grows. 
 • Establish the operating model: an intake and review framework with a published scope charter that defines functional ownership, and build team AI proficiency through continuous learning and tooling investments. 
 • Run a content engine that turns product updates into role-based knowledge assets, holding quality standards for brand voice, documentation structure, terminology and courseware. 
 • Manage knowledge base architecture and tagging for AI retrieval, categorize workflows by automation level so human oversight goes to high-judgment work, and set localization policies that pair AI-assisted translation with human review. 
 • Design modular, role-based learning programs (reserving live training for interactive problem-solving), including onboarding and enablement for internal teams and customers from unified content, plus badging and certification frameworks, grounded in practical hospitality context and product workflows. 
 • Manage live delivery schedules, global time-zone coverage, contractors, and the enablement platforms, vendors and content tools. 
 • Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Ops to define clear accountabilities, ensure releases meet customer readiness and learning standards before launch, bring customer feedback (support queries, AI gaps, community insights) into product needs, and track performance data to refine programs and show business value. 
 What Sets You Up for Success: 
 • Hospitality experience, meeting one of: 2+ years at group level (for example a large hotel management company or global brand); 5+ years at senior hotel management level in a large hotel or resort; or 5+ years in an area or regional role for a smaller chain, brand, ownership or management group. Experience limited to OTAs, GDS or travel distribution does not meet this requirement. 
 • 5+ years in training, enablement, learning and development, knowledge management or customer education, ideally in SaaS or hospitality technology. 
 • 2+ years leading a team, including specialists across several countries and time zones. 
 • A record of designing and running learning or content programs at scale with measured outcomes (such as time to competence, ticket deflection or content accuracy), and the analytical habits to turn throughput, survey and support data into priorities and a business case. 
 • Hands-on use of AI to produce and review content or training, with sound judgment about where AI must not replace human review, and experience with a learning management system (such as Docebo) and knowledge or content tools, or the ability to learn them quickly. 
 • Skill at setting scope and saying no clearly to partners across Product, Support, Sales and Operations, without relying on authority. 
 • Strong writing and clear spoken communication with a global audience, fluent English, and a self-directed, calm approach when priorities shift. A “mop bucket” attitude: some days you are the planner, the trainer, and the editor in the same afternoon. 
 Bonus Skills to Stand Out: 
 • Experience at a hospitality SaaS or PMS company, or in hotel training 
 • Instructional design or adult-learning qualification, or experience building certification, badging, customer education or community programs 
 • Portuguese, Spanish, or Thai; familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, Guru, ClickUp, Crowdin, and video production tools

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join:  
 Every day, Airbnb hosts provide unique Stays and Experiences that connect guests with local communities in authentic and meaningful ways. These offerings are the core of what makes Airbnb special — creating connections and unforgettable memories for travelers worldwide. 
 The Connectivity team sits at the heart of Airbnb’s Supply strategy, managing the API Partners that power a significant share of our global inventory. Our connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience. This team plays a critical role in growing, deepening, and shaping Airbnb’s partner ecosystem. 
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 As a Senior Partner Program Manager, you will run program management for Airbnb's Tier 3 connectivity book, including the long tail of unmanaged partners, and build the ecosystem partner program from the ground up. You are not managing a handful of accounts; you are designing and running the program that lets a small team credibly cover a big portfolio, and you are shaping how those partners show up on Airbnb. 
 You will bring a global view of the partner ecosystem, define success through Airbnb’s outcomes, and act as the connective tissue between partners, product teams, and internal stakeholders. You are someone who earns trust, moves fast, and holds yourself accountable for results.

 Build trusted relationships with founders and decision makers at ecosystem partners and represent Airbnb in external meetings and at industry events.

 Use AI tooling as part of the coverage model itself: triage, drafting, trigger handling and readouts that let one person hold a large book. 
 Execution & Ownership 
 Drive outcomes with minimal oversight. Own a full book of business end-to-end.  
 Act with speed and extreme ownership. This role is for someone who sees problems and fixes them and identifies opportunities. 
 Operate cross-functionally 
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Regional teams.

title: Senior Manager, Business Technology Enablement
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join:  
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead BizTech Enablement and Innovation (BEI), BizTech's solutions partner to the rest of the company. BEI works with Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Global Operations, Policy and Communications, Design, and other non-technical functions to understand how they work, turn their problems into working solutions, and make sure employees know about and adopt the technology BizTech provides. The team also brings what it learns back to BizTech product teams and vendors to shape their roadmaps. You will report to the Director, Tech Foundations.
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 This is a strategic leadership role within a large business unit. For the next 18 months, the team's focus is AI. You will own the company's approach to AI adoption and impact outside of Engineering, set the vision for AI-enabled work, hold functions accountable to measurable outcomes, and serve as BizTech's primary partner to E-Team leaders on AI transformation.
 More broadly, you will lead how Airbnb's non-technical functions discover, adopt, and get value from business technology. That covers quick consultations and fast-track solutions, go-to-market for new BizTech services, and building or buying new solutions where existing tools fall short. In the near term, you will define where Airbnb should be on AI-enabled work in two years, build the team and partnerships to get there, and make the trade-offs required to deliver it.
 Success in this role is measured in business outcomes, not tool rollouts: functions that have redesigned their work around technology and AI, defined their own impact metrics, and can show the efficiency and quality gains, supported by a simpler tool landscape with fewer duplicate and unsupported tools.
 A Typical Day:  
 Set strategy and vision 
 Help define and own the multi-year strategy for AI adoption and impact across Airbnb's non-technical functions, aligned with company and Tech priorities.
 Assess current gaps, existing capabilities, and emerging AI trends to anticipate how functions will need to work 18 to 24 months out, and translate that into a roadmap and investment.
Simplify the tools business teams use by steering them to supported solutions and closing the gaps that lead them to find their own.
 Set organizational OKRs and success criteria for near and long-term initiatives, and hold teams and partners accountable for delivery.
 Make and communicate hard trade-offs across competing functional demands, platform constraints, and budget.
 Drive executive alignment and function-level accountability 
 Serve as the senior BizTech partner to leadership teams on AI transformation, including regular readouts to executives and senior Tech leadership.
 Establish the framework by which each function defines, measures, and reports the business impact of AI, and drive adoption of that framework as a standard.
 Build a metric-driven accountability culture: clear baselines, targets, and ownership for every function, with a single trusted source of truth for adoption and impact data.
 Tailor narratives for different audiences, from detailed methodology with data and engineering partners to concise decision framing for executives.
 Seek feedback from partner teams and use it to improve delivery; raise risks to leadership early.
 Listen actively and anticipate where change will meet resistance.
 Build the operating model and ecosystem 
 Design and continuously refine the operating model that connects different technical functions and networks into one coordinated enablement system.
 Shape the enablement approach for AI usage so functions can build and share AI solutions at scale.
 Partner with platform and product teams to influence the AI tooling roadmap based on the needs of non-technical users.
 Direct external partner and consulting engagements, including scope, governance, and return on investment.
 Set quality, reliability, and security standards for the AI solutions the team and functions build; own operational issues in production and drive the fixes that prevent repeats.
 Make sure tech debt and the long-term upkeep of shipped solutions are prioritized across the team’s roadmap.
 Lead and grow the organization 
 Lead a multi-disciplinary, globally distributed organization including managers, Business Solutions Engineers, Systems Architects, and Program Managers.
 Create a team environment that values constructive debate, risk-taking, and learning from experiments, and that fosters belonging across regions.
 Build an 18+ month talent plan and a succession pipeline, including hiring at L10 and above.
 Coach, mentor, and grow the team to communicate clearly, resolve conflict early, and build inclusive teams.
 Champion innovation and continuous improvement 
 Pilot new technologies, including AI, with business teams, and hand proven solutions to product owners for long-term support.
 Coach leaders across functions to connect AI capabilities to business value.
 Establish mechanisms that turn learnings from individual functions into reusable patterns across the company.
 Cultural and functional excellence 
 Represent BizTech in company-wide AI forums and contribute to hiring committees, talent processes, and Airbnb's internal AI community.
 Role model Airbnb's core values and strengthen the company's mission through the way AI is introduced to employees.
 Your Expertise: 
 12+ years of industry experience in business technology, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or technical program leadership, including 5+ years leading managers and multi-disciplinary teams.
